title: Transit staff tentative labour agreement approved
subtitle: Three-year Unifor Local 4304 agreement, wage increases, and benefit and scheduling changes at a short special meeting.
overview: Regional Council met in a short special meeting to consider a labour relations matter. Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Agreement with the Region's transit staff, represented by Unifor Local 4304 {{vote:m2}}. The agreement runs three years, from May 1, 2026, to April 30, 2029.

The recommendation came from the Closed Committee, and staff gave a summary in open session. Staff said the deal includes a wage increase starting May 1, 2026, a cost of living increase on May 1, 2027, minor benefit enhancements, changes to scheduling language and additions to shift premiums.

For residents, the agreement sets labour costs for transit staff for the next three years and supports continued transit service. Councillors thanked both bargaining teams and described the result as fair to employees and affordable to residents. Council then passed the routine confirming by-law and adjourned.

decisions.detail: Council approved a tentative three-year Memorandum of Agreement with Unifor Local 4304 for the Region's transit staff, running from May 1, 2026, to April 30, 2029.

debate: One councillor asked why the agreement's details were not part of the motion, given that the bargaining unit had already approved it and Council was now voting.
Staff said details are not always included in motions but are usually shared in a media release afterward, and had no concern with adding them. They then read the main terms into the public record.
Staff outlined a wage increase from May 1, 2026, a cost of living increase on May 1, 2027, minor benefit enhancements, scheduling language changes and added shift premiums.
Councillors thanked staff and the union bargaining team for working collaboratively. They said the outcome was reasonable and balanced, fair to employees and affordable to residents.
